speaker_tag.description: Exact tag used before ': ' in dialogue lines, e.g. কমলা / Narrator.

voice_slot.description: Fixed production voice map (see Prompt 1). Gender must match the character.

finale.description: True only for a series finale (closed warm ending instead of a cliffhanger).

hook_line.description: Copy of the first Narrator line (the opening mega-hook).

language.description: Dialogue language; must match the input story.

characters_present.description: speaker_tags on screen in this scene (drives reference-image selection).

emotion.description: Dominant beat, e.g. fear / wonder / greed / menace.

text.description: One breath of dialogue; TTS joins as 'Speaker: text'.

setting.description: Place + time of day, one short phrase.

title: ToonForge script.json — output of Prompt 1 (Director: story → script)
